quotes.text: We decided on an impromptu fishing charter after losing a baseball tournament at Cedar point..We were SO lucky that Captain JJ was available to take us out. He was great at finding the fish, helping us fish, and keeping the rods out in the water. What a hard worker! Definitely a nice way to spend our Sunday! My youngest son started getting sick towards the end, and still got back to shore and said he had a great time. Thanks for the awesome experience, we were excited to catch so many fish!

First time experience with seeing red this past weekend was beyond expectations. Everything paid for was provided as promised. Lodging clean and ready to go for us. Cap JJ had all necessary equipment needed as the fishing "changed up" throughout our stay. Walked away with only one complaint: Not enough beer can holders holders on the boat.That I can live with! We will be back.

Family friendly with patience to teach children how to perch fish. Captain JJ helped consistently with bait & removing fish. JJ’s charter delivered what was promised per his website. He was able to get us to sites where we were catching fish, and we reached our catch limit. Our children had a great time. Thanks for a fun family experience

JJ was very knowledgeable and brought to some good spots. Tested out the area and moved on if they weren’t biting. Once we were on the walleyes it was unreal. We will definitely be back and would not use another charter. If you want fish, do not hesitate to use Seeing Red Charters! Thanks again JJ, hopefully we will see you next year.

Capt JJ is one of the best fishing guides I’ve ever fished with. I Took my son and several buddies and he put us on the fish. Great boat, equipment, and customer service. Capt JJ is a genuine nice guy that will help you get the fish and have a great time. Can’t go wrong with Seeing Red Charters- Thanks Capt. JJ

I cannot speak highly enough of our morning trip with Captain JJ! We had so much fun! He was a great instructor, captain, and fist mate of all rolls into one! He knew where to put the boat, what the walleyes wanted to bite on, and get us a full limit to bring home! Thank you JJ!!!! We will DEFINITELY be back!
